verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Resolution feature, powered by OpenAI or Azure OpenAI, sends the stack trace, environment and affected code to an LLM and returns suggestions on the root cause and how to fix it. It also offers a collaborative chat. The documented AI context does not include breadcrumbs or related commits, and it requires the user's own OpenAI API key. There is no hands-on corroboration of the quality of its suggestions. Missing for 10: breadcrumbs as AI input, related commits as AI input, independent evidence of root-cause accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI analyzes an issue — stack trace, breadcrumbs, related commits — and proposes a root cause I can act on

citations.quote: Resolve issues with unprecedented speed and accuracy using AI-powered suggestions on the root cause of errors and how to fix them.
Auto-prompt your chosen LLM with crucial error context from your stack trace, environment, and affected code to get fast and accurate solutions.
This feature allows you to identify and tackle errors swiftly with just a click, using advanced AI technology powered by OpenAI and Azure OpenAI.
Enter your OpenAI API key and select your preferred GPT model (GPT-4 is default).
